name: ai-model-wechat
description: Use this skill for WeChat Mini Program AI via wx.cloud.extend.AI (小程序, wx.cloud apps). Covers generateText and streamText with callbacks (onText, onEvent, onFinish); streamText needs a data wrapper, generateText returns the raw response. Also covers multimodal image input (image_url content blocks, OCR and form extraction) — vision-capable models only. Models via wx.cloud.extend.AI.createModel with groups cloudbase (main managed, also 小程序成长计划 with `hy4-preview` / `hy3` / `deepseek-v4.1-flash`),
author: TencentCloudBase
